verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents first-party natural-language operation in two ways. Its remote MCP Server lets you "analyze your data using natural language... without writing SQL", now including read-write actions via query_rw. Dives are built from natural-language prompts and refined conversationally ("add a filter for US region", "switch to a bar chart"), with Guides supplying org context so agents write accurate SQL. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the natural-language features, and evidence that administrative operations (sharing, billing, instance management) can be driven by natural language rather than only data querying and visualization.
